macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature, projecting upward and backward from the skull with an inward taper at the distal ends.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white spinal mane and a long, dark ventral fringe. Distinct orange-tan pelage on the lower limbs starting below the carpal and tarsal joints.
